data.description: Is the sole operational writer and two-store saga orchestrator for PortableProject Runs. It durably records PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1 as PendingPortableCommit before portable head publication, finalizes HeadLinked only after exact portable CommitId/head/checkpoint verification, and releases acknowledgements or dispatch only after both states are durable. It never writes a local SemanticEvent stream
data.technology: Sealed PortableRuntimeJournalWritePort with Aworkit DTOs over Rust and SQLite transactions
